title: from-space-to-sediment
description: Open framework and code for screening candidate e-waste processing and dumping sites in Thailand with multi-sensor satellite data (Google Earth Engine), verifying them against the national factory registry and public records, and attributing river contamination to upstream sources with along-network distances, an e-waste marker suite and a four-criterion evidence rule (detection, hydrological connectivity, geochemistry, chronology). Case study: the Bang Pakong basin. Companion software to the preprint "From Space to Sediment: An Integrated Multi-Sensor Remote Sensing and Geochemical Fingerprinting Framework for Detecting E-Waste Hotspots and Attributing River Contamination in Thailand".
